text:
ProductOps: PSA — security triage found an N+1 CVE in our model-serving HTTP layer. We need a coordinated response: temporary release freeze for feature rollouts that touch serving, routing, or network config. Freeze effective now until 2026-05-03T10:00:00Z, unless an exemption is approved.
Tom H.: ack. Can we clarify scope? Is this only hosted infra or includes Dedicated/Private deployments?
Leah R.: scope: hosted API + dedicated pools. Private customers get a security advisory and patch guidance (not auto-enforced). This freeze blocks: new model variants touching the serving binary, network config changes, and runtime-level feature flags that alter ingress. UI/SDK client updates that are backward compatible are fine.
deploy-bot: security_alert: CVE-2026-0421 detected in xhttp-proxy v2.3. Pending hotfix rollout. All scheduled non-critical deploys paused.
Marco T.: practical ask: existing canaries with <1% error and no binary changes can continue at reduced traffic (max 5%). Anything that changes runtime binary or inbound routing must stop.
Priya S.: QA note: we need to run the quick regression suite and perf smoke test after the patch. Timeline target: hotfix rollout + smoke by 2026-05-02 22:00 UTC.
Tom H.: temporary canary policy we want enabled until the patch: auto-throttle to 5% traffic, tighten error thresholds (1% uplift over baseline for 5m triggers pause), require explicit approver (security or release lead) to resume above 5%.
Leah R.: adding an exemption path: to request a migration/rollout during freeze, submit a short RFC in #eng-releases with: owner, reason, mitigation steps, rollback playbook, perf numbers, and sec sign-off. We will review within 2 working hours.
Marco T.: putting snippet for the canary config that ops will apply centrally: ```json
{"max_traffic_percent": 5, "error_uplift_pct": 1.0, "window_minutes": 5, "resume_requires": ["security.leah","release.tom"]}
```
infra-oncall: infra rota updated for the night of the patch. Im assigning one infra lead + runtime lead for the 3-hour window after deploy. Please add your pager in the RFC.
ProductOps: also: please pause any schema migrations touching routing tables or edge config until post-patch. Small, read-only index changes may be allowed with review.
Tom H.: will add a pinned checklist to the release runbook: short audit trail, smoke result screenshot, and the RFC link for exemptions.
Priya S.: QA will prioritize the smoke suite on staging and will post the pass/fail in this thread.
Leah R.: final: everyone, if you have open experiments (feature flags, long-lived canaries), mark them here and set traffic cap to <=5% now. We'll publish a status update at 18:00 UTC today.
ProductOps: thanks — expect an official summary + KB article in ~1 hour.
